welcome.title: Welcome to Golf Swing Lab
welcome.body: Put your phone on a tripod and every swing gets measured: tempo, body motion and club speed.
welcome.p1: Live mode: just set up and swing, no tapping
welcome.p2: Slow-motion import: adds ball speed and carry
welcome.p3: Everything stays on this phone: no upload, no account
need.title: What you need
need.body: Bring these on your first visit; after that you only set up the tripod.
need.tripod: A phone tripod that reaches at least 1.7 m
need.tape: A tape measure, to measure the mat once
install.title: Add to your Home Screen
install.body: Opening it from the Home Screen works best: full screen, works offline, and your data is less likely to be cleared.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
install.ios2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”
install.ios3: From now on, open it from the Home Screen icon
install.other1: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
install.other2: From now on, open it from the Home Screen icon
install.evict_title: Without the Home Screen icon your data can be cleared
install.evict_body: iPhone clears data of websites you have not used for a while. Add the app to your Home Screen and back up from History now and then.
install.offline_unknown: Offline files download in the background; stay online for a moment
you.title: About you
you.body: These help us scale body and club numbers. You can change them later in Settings.
you.height_bad: That height does not look right; please try again
perm.title: Permissions
perm.body: Tap “Allow” once and the phone asks for each one. You can still use the app if you say no, with fewer features.
perm.camera_why: Films your swing. Without it you can only import videos.
perm.microphone_why: Hears the strike, to tell real swings from practice swings.
perm.motion_why: Works as a spirit level to get the phone straight.
perm.camera_fix_denied: In iPhone Settings › Safari › Camera choose “Allow”, or import videos instead.
perm.camera_fix_busy: Close the app that is using the camera (for example a video call) and try again.
perm.camera_fix_unsupported: This device cannot record: import videos instead.
perm.microphone_fix_denied: That is fine: swings are detected from motion only, so a practice swing may count as a shot.
perm.microphone_fix_busy: The microphone is busy: end the call and try again.
perm.microphone_fix_unsupported: No microphone: swings are detected from motion only.
perm.motion_fix_denied: That is fine: line up with the on-screen frame during setup.
perm.motion_fix_busy: The level is not available right now; try again later.
perm.motion_fix_unsupported: This device has no level sensor: line up with the on-screen frame instead.
perm.result_camera_off: The camera is off: you can still import slow-motion videos.
first.title: How do you want to start?
first.body: You can switch at any time on the Practice screen.
first.live_body: Set up the phone and hit; every shot is analysed automatically.
first.live_gets: Tempo, backswing and downswing time, head movement
first.highspeed_body: Record slow motion with the iPhone Camera app, then import it here.
first.highspeed_gets: Adds ball speed, club speed and carry
